nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Amazon Ads: sb/keywords API. Uses your Nexscope Amazon Ads connection. Credentials remain on the server. Mutations require preview and confirmation.

accept.description: V4 create/update uses `application/vnd.sbkeywordresponse.v3+json`; V4 GET list uses `application/vnd.sbkeyword.v3+json`; V3 compatible scripts are usually not passed.

body.description: Payload must be provided when creating or modifying POST/PUT; GET list passes paging and filtering parameters through queryString.

confirmationToken.description: For mutations, first preview without a token, then confirm using the returned single-use token.

connectionId.description: An Amazon Ads connection owned by the authenticated Nexscope user.

contentType.description: POST/PUT uses `application/json`; GET list does not send Content-Type.

fetchAll.description: Automatic page turning; SP and SB V4 main resource lists use `nextToken`, SB Target/BudgetRule uses `nextToken` (BudgetRule query must contain `pageSize`), SB Keyword GET, SB V3 GET and SD use `startIndex + count`.

includeExtendedDataFields.description: Some entities return extended fields; SD is switched through the /extended path.

locale.description: Localization parameters (supported by some keyword scripts).

maxResults.description: Single page 1–100; SD corresponds to count.

method.description: Upstream HTTP method: `GET/POST/PUT`; GET is used for keyword list, POST/PUT is used for creation/modification.

queryString.description: Pass upstream query parameters when needed.
